The branching node graph is an independent version-control action graphic beside and overlapping a separate code panel; the panel itself hosts a reusable code glyph.

## Visual draft

A three-node vertical chain at left branches through a fourth node into an upward-left arrow. Beside it, an open rounded panel surrounds a code mark composed of two angle brackets and a slash.

## 1. Open rounded code panel (container)

A rounded rectangular panel with an opening along the upper-left area. Complete its standalone boundary as appropriate; exclude the node graph, arrow, and code glyph.

## 2. Branching revision graph (sub)

Three circular nodes form a vertical chain, with a curved branch passing through a fourth node and ending in an arrow pointing upper-left. Exclude the code panel and bracket-and-slash glyph.

## 3. Code brackets and slash (sub)

Two opposing angle brackets surround a diagonal forward slash. Exclude the panel enclosure and branching node graph.
